# dsh-onlyoffice
**English** | 中文

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that opens **.docx / .xlsx / .pptx** files from the
Harness sidebar file m

anagers and edits them in an embedded **OnlyOffice**
editor — client-side static SDK, **no Document

Server, no backend conversion
service**. Documents never leave the machine; the only network traffic

is
fetching the OpenOffice-format engine assets once (cached on disk).

| Package | `@dake6767/dsh-onlyoffice` (npm) — linked directory install in the `desktop` profile |
|
Host half | `lib/index.js` — `/dsh-onlyoffice/*` routes (SDK proxy + cache, read/write, diagnostics

) |
| Client half | `lib/client.js` — one module-loader bundle, three consumers of the vendored engi

ne |
| Engine | `onlyoffice-web-comp` vendored under `vendor/onlyoffice-web-comp` (patched: `vendor/
| `onlyoffice-web-comp` vendored under `vendor/onlyoffice-web-comp` (patched: `vendor/PATCHES.md`) |
## What it does

- **Two integration paths, one engine**
- **DSH built-in document preview** (primary, no third-party

dependency):
registers a document implementation through `ctx.documentPreviews` plus the
keyed `sid

ebar.right.tab.document` slot (`loading: 'renderer'`).
- **dsh-better-sidebar** (optional): register

s three file viewers through
`ctx.betterSidebar.registerFileViewer`. The service is awaited across l

oad
order (get → optional inject → bounded poll), so the two plugins compose in
either boot order.
-

**Edit + save back to the original file**
- `⌘S` / `Ctrl+S` inside the editor (the vendor's save-sh

ortcut blocker is
re-pointed at this plugin) and the editor's own save affordance
(`onSave` → `ONSAV

E`) both write the document back.
- **Auto-save**: every document change schedules a debounced (1.8

s idle)
write-back; manual saves flush immediately. Saves are silent.
- **External changes are detec

ted, never swapped underneath you**: the preview
watcher reports a new file version; the viewer show

s
*“文件已在磁盘上更新。［重新加载］”* and you decide when to reload.
- **Export** the edited document as a download

duct**: viewer failures render the captured
console/iframe errors and an environment snapshot, and r

eport to
`POST /dsh-onlyoffice/diagnostic` (appended to `<cacheDir>/.requests.log`).
## Requirements

- A DSH build whose client exposes `documentPreviews` + `slots` (the shipped
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-clien

t-ui-sidebar-documentpreview`) and, for the optional
path, `dsh-better-sidebar`.
- Network access to
one of the SDK mirrors on first open (see below).

## Install
> Deployments behind a reverse proxy are supported: the plugin resolves its routes agains
t the page directory, so a GUI served at `https://host/app/<id>/` works the same as `http://127.0.0.
1:53803/` or the desktop shell `dsh-app://app/`.

The bundle is a linked directory; `plugin_manager install_bundle` with
`target: /Users/wuliqi/projec

ts/dsh-onlyoffice` adds the dependency and the
profile bundle row. A page refresh (`Cmd+R`) loads cl

ient changes; **host-half
changes need a full DSH restart** (HMR is not reliable for the linked host

ges; **host-half
changes need a full DSH restart** (HMR is not reliable for the linked host
module).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## OnlyOffice static SDK: where the engine comes from

The SDK tree is ~19.6k files / 1.1 GB and is distributed separately. The Host
reads a prepared share

d copy when configured, then falls back to its writable
member cache and upstream mirrors.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Default ordered mirrors (failover on network error / timeout / 404 / 5xx):

1. `https://onlyoffice-web-comp.vercel.app/packages`
2. `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/electroluxcode/

onlyoffice-web-comp@main/public/packages`
3. `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/electroluxcode/onlyo
ffice-web-comp/main/public/packages`

Definitive 404s (e.g. `dictionaries/en_US/*`, absent from every mirror) are
remembered for 10 minute

s so they do not re-walk the mirror chain on every
render.
### Configuration (`cordis.patch.yml` row `onlyoffice`)
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Offline / intranet: pre-populate `cacheDir` with the same directory layout, or
point `upstreamBase`
at a self-hosted static copy.
### Shared SDK with a writable member fallback

Set `DSH_ONLYOFFICE_SHARED_CACHE_DIR` (0.1.9+) to a prepared SDK root visible to
each Host process:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Mount this directory read-only for members. Shared hits contact no upstream and
write nothing into t

he shared tree. Missing, inaccessible or non-file entries
fall back to the member cache; symlinks re

solving outside the shared root are
ignored. A newly available shared file takes priority over both

a member copy
and a remembered upstream 404.

Downloads and request logs stay in the writable cache. Its existing precedence
is unchanged: explici

t plugin `cacheDir`, then `DSH_ONLYOFFICE_CACHE_DIR`, then
`$DSH_HOME/onlyoffice-sdk`. The older `DS

H_ONLYOFFICE_CACHE_DIR` setting still
selects a writable cache; use the separate shared setting for

a read-only mount.
`/status` file and byte counts describe only the writable cache.
## HTTP routes (all behind the connection fence, same as `/sidebar/*`)
| Route | Purpose |

| `GET /status` | `{version, sdkBaseUrl, upstreams, cacheDir, files, bytes, lastError}` |
| `GET /sd

k/onlyoffice/<ver>/<rest>` | SDK proxy + disk cache (immutable headers) |
| `GET /read?sessionId&pat

h[&cwd]` | document bytes + `x-dsh-file-version` (renderer mode) |
| `POST /save?sessionId&path[&cwd

][&mtimeMs]` | atomic write-back of raw document bytes |
| `POST /diagnostic` | bounded browser diag
nostic line → `.requests.log` |

**Write safety** (the only writer in the plugin): target must already exist and
be a regular file in

side the session workspace (`fs.contains`, realpath fallback);
extension must be `docx/xlsx/pptx` (t

he engine's native output — writing docx
bytes over `.odt/.doc/.csv` would corrupt them, those stay
ame-directory temp file + rename, original mode preserved.
## Known limitations
